notes.title: Not gone, just shy
notes.content:
A lot of things did happen during the last eight months.
So much stuff, not enough time to write a post.

Here's some of the changes you can check in the [u]unstable[/u] beta branch:
[list]
[*] Hard mode
[*] New and better combat music
[*] New weapons
[*] New ammo boxes
[*] New levels and a lot of small changes to all the levels
[*] Blood splatters
[*] In-game vending machines (only for in-game money)
[*] Main menu redone
[*] Use key and usable objects
[*] Jumping and firing input buffering
[*] Small explodies now damage other enemies when they explode
[*] Terminal ballistics force vector corrected
[*] The demo doesn't throw you to the main menu after completing the tutorial, instead loading the next level
[*] Item outlines are now visible when they should and not visible when they shouldn't
[*] Better static objects collisions, but I'll make it even better for the next stable release
[*] Gnoo movement behavior reworked, but it will be reworked again in the future
[*] Doors behave better, but I'll make them behave even better for the next release
[*] Fixed focused checkbox style
[*] Rapto fireballs can hit you from much longer range
[*] Rapto fireballs can damage other enemies too
[*] Weapons are held closer to the camera
[*] Shaders reconfigured to appear more detailed
[/list]

A lot of things will happen in the future.
The game is slowly entering phase of pre-polishing for the purpose of attracting a publisher or an investor to secure budget.
Once budget is secured, expect to see lots of new levels and even more visual changes.
My goal is to make an eye-candy with deep story you'll fall in love with.

Here's my promise: the game will never have anything you can buy with real money besides the game itself. No microtransactions, no in-apps, no NTF, no horse armor, not even any cosmetics.
A large expansion pack with a story campaign may happen, I'll keep its price reasonable.

notes.title: March 2022 AMA summary
notes.content:
[i][b]Q[/b]: How do I beat Barrels of fun?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: You are not supposed to beat this, the goal of the challenge is to kill and loot as much as you can.

[i][b]Q[/b]: is this something new or is it an old game?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: It's so new it's not even released yet and probably won't be for another year or two.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Why does it feel so hard?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Because it is, unlike most new games, not too easy.
If it feels too hard, try that green button in the main menu.

[i][b]Q[/b]: What if I can't survive the ambush in the tutorial?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: If you can't survive it, it's game over.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Why does it sound so random?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Most of the current sound effects are temporary placeholders.
I promise to replace those with something much better closer to the release.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Will the game be available only on Steam?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: No, there will be other ways to buy the game.

[i][b]Q[/b]: What are those creatures?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: You can check creatures and other objects names in main menu → credits → more credits

[i][b]Q[/b]: Is there any difference from one handgun to another?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Yes, revolver, for example, shoots much faster, deadlier and more accurate bullets.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Does it take two bullets to kill fireball throwing enemy?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Bullets deal less damage less velocity they have.
So if you shoot from further away, you'll need more bullets to kill the same enemy.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Are there any automatic weapons?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Not yet, but some are planned.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Is this the Flight of the Bumblebee playing when enemies are attacking?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: Yup, that's a modern remix of that.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Why is this background music is so amazing?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: It was created by Alexander Nakarada, he's good at composing music and also a good person.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Isn't this amount of grass too much?[/i]
[b]A[/b]: You can reduce it in the settings if you don't like it.

[i][b]Q[/b]: Someone please give me a revolver already, Shifting rock ravine is too hard without it![/i]
[b]A[/b]: It's hidden right behind starting point, turn around and look behind the hubble.

notes.title: Shroomscape zone is now on Steam
notes.content:
Good news, we have a page in Steam now!

It will take some time before the game will become available here, I want it to have more content and be worthy of your money.

The demo will become available as soon as I figure out Steam features integration (achievements, cloud saves and what else).
And it will be free.

Eventually (before the release) the game will be localized to multiple languages, so those who want to enjoy it not in English will be able to.
